name: pm
description: Project-management layer for agentic development. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only — every other folder is created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy) with docs/TASKS.md as the task list unless the project names another tracker; discovery riffs work into docs/intent/<slug>.md with a size call; whats-next and stepping-away open and close each working SESSION as per-session, per-person append-only logs and keep the task list current; checkpoint re-aims a session too long to close and reopen; sibling-sessions runs two or three independent items side by side; verify-before-done gates completion claims on fresh evidence; the credential-guard hook blocks staging credential-shaped files. adversary-review hands a risky change to a fresh read-only Claude subagent that tries to break it against its acceptance lines; ship-acceptance checks a deliverable against its accepted intent, by someone who did not build it, and records the evidence; Utility skill: okf (knowledge-bundle format). SDLC.md is the doctrine; WORKFLOW.md binds it to these skills.
